005package com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.controller.PIDController;
008import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
009import org.wpilib.math.system.DCMotor;
010import org.wpilib.math.system.Models;
011import org.wpilib.math.util.Units;
012import org.wpilib.simulation.DCMotorSim;
013import org.wpilib.system.Timer;
014
015import com.ctre.phoenix6.configs.CANcoderConfiguration;
016import com.ctre.phoenix6.configs.TalonFXConfiguration;
017import com.ctre.phoenix6.swerve.SwerveModuleConstants;
018
019/**
020 * Physics sim implementation of module IO. The sim models are configured using a set of module
021 * constants from Phoenix. Simulation is always based on voltage control.
022 */
023public class ModuleIOSim implements ModuleIO {
024    // TunerConstants doesn't support separate sim constants, so they are declared
025    // locally
026    private static final double DRIVE_KP = 0.05;
027    private static final double DRIVE_KD = 0.0;
028    private static final double DRIVE_KS = 0.0;
029    private static final double DRIVE_KV_ROT =
030            0.91035; // Same units as TunerConstants: (volt * secs) / rotation
031    private static final double DRIVE_KV = 1.0 / Units.rotationsToRadians(1.0 / DRIVE_KV_ROT);
032    private static final double TURN_KP = 8.0;
033    private static final double TURN_KD = 0.0;
034    private static final DCMotor DRIVE_GEARBOX = DCMotor.getKrakenX60Foc(1);
035    private static final DCMotor TURN_GEARBOX = DCMotor.getKrakenX60Foc(1);
036
037    private final DCMotorSim driveSim;
038    private final DCMotorSim turnSim;
039
040    private boolean driveClosedLoop = false;
041    private boolean turnClosedLoop = false;
042    private PIDController driveController = new PIDController(DRIVE_KP, 0, DRIVE_KD);
043    private PIDController turnController = new PIDController(TURN_KP, 0, TURN_KD);
044    private double driveFFVolts = 0.0;
045    private double driveAppliedVolts = 0.0;
046    private double turnAppliedVolts = 0.0;
047
048    public ModuleIOSim(
049            SwerveModuleConstants<TalonFXConfiguration, TalonFXConfiguration, CANcoderConfiguration>
050                    constants) {
051        // Create drive and turn sim models
052        driveSim =
053                new DCMotorSim(
054                        Models.singleJointedArmFromPhysicalConstants( // Recommended model by
055                                // documentation
056                                DRIVE_GEARBOX,
057                                constants.DriveInertia,
058                                constants.DriveMotorGearRatio),
059                        DRIVE_GEARBOX);
060        turnSim =
061                new DCMotorSim(
062                        Models.singleJointedArmFromPhysicalConstants(
063                                TURN_GEARBOX,
064                                constants.SteerInertia,
065                                constants.SteerMotorGearRatio),
066                        TURN_GEARBOX);
067
068        // Enable wrapping for turn PID
069        turnController.enableContinuousInput(-Math.PI, Math.PI);
070    }
071
072    @Override
073    public void updateInputs(ModuleIOInputs inputs) {
074        // Run closed-loop control
075        if (driveClosedLoop) {
076            driveAppliedVolts =
077                    driveFFVolts + driveController.calculate(driveSim.getAngularVelocity());
078        } else {
079            driveController.reset();
080        }
081        if (turnClosedLoop) {
082            turnAppliedVolts = turnController.calculate(turnSim.getAngularPosition());
083        } else {
084            turnController.reset();
085        }
086
087        // Update simulation state
088        driveSim.setInputVoltage(Math.clamp(driveAppliedVolts, -12.0, 12.0));
089        turnSim.setInputVoltage(Math.clamp(turnAppliedVolts, -12.0, 12.0));
090        driveSim.update(0.02);
091        turnSim.update(0.02);
092
093        // Update drive inputs
094        inputs.driveConnected = true;
095        inputs.drivePositionRad = driveSim.getAngularPosition();
096        inputs.driveVelocityRadPerSec = driveSim.getAngularVelocity();
097        inputs.driveAppliedVolts = driveAppliedVolts;
098        inputs.driveCurrentAmps = Math.abs(driveSim.getCurrentDraw());
099
100        // Update turn inputs
101        inputs.turnConnected = true;
102        inputs.turnEncoderConnected = true;
103        inputs.turnAbsolutePosition = new Rotation2d(turnSim.getAngularPosition());
104        inputs.turnPosition = new Rotation2d(turnSim.getAngularPosition());
105        inputs.turnVelocityRadPerSec = turnSim.getAngularVelocity();
106        inputs.turnAppliedVolts = turnAppliedVolts;
107        inputs.turnCurrentAmps = Math.abs(turnSim.getCurrentDraw());
108
109        // Update odometry inputs (50Hz because high-frequency odometry in sim doesn't
110        // matter)
111        inputs.odometryTimestamps = new double[] {Timer.getMonotonicTimestamp()};
112        inputs.odometryDrivePositionsRad = new double[] {inputs.drivePositionRad};
113        inputs.odometryTurnPositions = new Rotation2d[] {inputs.turnPosition};
114    }
115
116    @Override
117    public void setDriveOpenLoop(double output) {
118        driveClosedLoop = false;
119        driveAppliedVolts = output;
120    }
121
122    @Override
123    public void setTurnOpenLoop(double output) {
124        turnClosedLoop = false;
125        turnAppliedVolts = output;
126    }
127
128    @Override
129    public void setDriveVelocity(double velocityRadPerSec) {
130        driveClosedLoop = true;
131        driveFFVolts = DRIVE_KS * Math.signum(velocityRadPerSec) + DRIVE_KV * velocityRadPerSec;
132        driveController.setSetpoint(velocityRadPerSec);
133    }
134
135    @Override
136    public void setTurnPosition(Rotation2d rotation) {
137        turnClosedLoop = true;
138        turnController.setSetpoint(rotation.getRadians());
139    }
140}
